scope: Nigerian source snapshots and explicitly fictional office policies. Labels describe these documents, not current legal advice.

questions.question: What does the domain management policy say about the fee for registering a .gov.ng domain?
expected_points: The policy states that .gov.ng domain registration is free.

expected_citations.evidence: The registration of .gov.ng domain name is free and will always be free.

questions.question: Where must the administrative contact for a .gov.ng domain reside?
expected_points: The administrative contact must reside within the requesting organisation.

expected_citations.evidence: The administrative contact must reside within the organization who is requesting for the domain.

questions.question: What contact details should a government website contact page provide?
expected_points: The contact page should include a functional phone number and a monitored email address.

expected_citations.doc: Standards and Guidelines for Government Websites V3
expected_citations.evidence: a functional phone number and a monitored email address

questions.question: Must discussion forums on government websites be moderated?
expected_points: The website guidelines require discussion forums to be moderated.

expected_citations.doc: Standards and Guidelines for Government Websites V3
expected_citations.evidence: It is MANDATORY that discussion forums be moderated

questions.question: May government officials use personal social media accounts for official engagement?
expected_points: The framework says officials shall not use personal social media accounts for official engagement.

expected_citations.doc: Framework and Guidelines for the Use of Social Media Platforms in Public Institutions
expected_citations.evidence: not use personal Social Media accounts for official engagement

questions.question: What social media usage objectives should a public institution define?
expected_points: Each public institution shall define its social media usage objectives.

expected_citations.doc: Framework and Guidelines for the Use of Social Media Platforms in Public Institutions
expected_citations.evidence: Every PI shall define their Social Media usage objectives.

questions.question: What website domain is required for an indigenous ICT service provider seeking registration?
expected_points: Applicants must have their website hosted on the .ng domain.

expected_citations.doc: Guidelines for Registration of ICT Service Providers/Contractors for Delivery of IT Services to MDAs
expected_citations.evidence: that have their website hosted on the .ng domain

questions.question: How early must an ICT service provider submit a registration renewal application?
expected_points: Renewals must be submitted at least three months before the certificate expires.

expected_citations.doc: Guidelines for Registration of ICT Service Providers/Contractors for Delivery of IT Services to MDAs
expected_citations.evidence: at least 3months before the expiration

questions.question: What two technical requirements does Ne-GIF identify for achieving interoperability?
expected_points: The framework specifies adoption of open standards and definition of metadata standards.

expected_citations.evidence: 1. Adoption of Open Standards; and 2. Metadata Standards Definition.

questions.question: Who coordinates the Nigerian e-Government Interoperability Framework?
expected_points: Stakeholders are co-owners while NITDA coordinates the framework.

expected_citations.evidence: all stakeholders are regarded as co-owners of the framework while NITDA coordinates

questions.question: What must a data subject be told about withdrawing consent under the 2019 regulation?
expected_points: The data subject must be informed of the right and method to withdraw consent.

expected_citations.evidence: informed of his right and method to withdraw his consent at any given time

questions.question: How should a privacy policy be displayed where personal data is collected?
expected_points: The medium must display a simple and conspicuous privacy policy understandable to the target data subjects.

expected_citations.evidence: shall display a simple and conspicuous privacy policy

questions.question: Which encryption standard does the 2026 cloud guideline specify for data at rest and in transit?
expected_points: The guideline specifies AES-256 encryption or higher.

expected_citations.evidence: Encryption for data at rest and in transit must utilise AES-256 encryption or higher.

questions.question: What should a cloud service agreement exit strategy cover?
expected_points: The exit strategy should cover secure data repatriation and deletion when the contract terminates.

expected_citations.evidence: Procedures for secure data repatriation and deletion upon contract termination.

questions.question: What defines a Large Service Platform in the 2022 code of practice?
expected_points: The definition uses more than one million registered users in Nigeria.

expected_citations.doc: Code of Practice for Interactive Computer Service Platforms/Internet Intermediaries 2022
expected_citations.evidence: registered Users in Nigeria are more than one million (1,000,000)

questions.question: What Nigerian presence is required of Large Service Platforms?
expected_points: Large Service Platforms shall have a physical contact address in Nigeria.

expected_citations.doc: Code of Practice for Interactive Computer Service Platforms/Internet Intermediaries 2022
expected_citations.evidence: Have a physical contact address in Nigeria.
